{{Top|leg}}
The '''G47 Tractor Beam Generator''' was a heavy-duty [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]] produced by [[Novaldex/Legends|Novaldex]]. Made for use on [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] which moved [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] used sixteen pairs of them to maintain the sense of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], as well as to draw in [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] for refinement and to draw in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] heat to drive the [[thermo-converter]]s that powered the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|floating]] [[City/Legends|city]].
